entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I hope you can help. I'm calling about an order, and I... I feel terrible, but I need to make a return.
I'm sorry to hear that you're not completely satisfied. I can certainly help you with that. Could I get your name and order number to start?
Yes, it's under Marcus Thorne, order number 774-29B. It's for the Aero-Dynamic helmet. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I really hate to do this.

Thank you, Mr. Thorne. I see your account here, and we really appreciate your loyalty. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh no, there's nothing wrong with it at all. The box is still unopened. It's just... the color. It looked different on the website, and now that I have it, it just doesn't match my gear. Honestly, with things being a bit tight, I was really hoping I could get the money back.

I completely understand. It's important that you love the look of your gear, especially the color. Your safety is always our top priority, but we want you to feel confident in your style, too. Let me just pull up the delivery date for you.
Okay, I see here that the helmet was delivered to you 81 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day window for a standard return.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief. I was so worried I had waited too long. Thank you, Diana.

It's absolutely no problem. And since you're a VIP member, I want to make this as easy as possible. I've just gone ahead and emailed you a prepaid return label, and I've also waived the standard restocking fee for you.
You waived the fee? Wow. That is incredibly kind. You've really helped me out today, more than you know. Thank you so much.

You are very welcome, Mr. Thorne. Just place that label on the original shipping box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your full refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for being so helpful.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
